decision: Run the existing Django suite offline before source edits
why: Establish actual failures instead of trusting the discovery snapshot

decision: Remove generated runtime files from the Git index only
why: Improve hygiene without deleting environments logs or data
result: 496 files preserved locally; database hash unchanged

decision: Use a separate supported workspace environment and an opt-in legacy research profile
why: Preserve scientific dependencies and original data while removing import-time remote clients
result: 29 supported and 23 legacy tests pass; full scientific reinstall remains open

decision: Pin patched DRF 3.18.3 and compatible Celery/beat versions
why: The initial package audit reproduced five DRF advisories
result: No known vulnerabilities in audited supported sets

decision: Keep synthetic fixtures explicit and never substitute them after a market provider failure
why: No licensed market-data contract was supplied
result: Demo provenance checked; provider-success and redistribution rights remain open

decision: Use session API contracts and actual chart/table agreement in browser acceptance
why: Runtime verification exposed rewrite, formatter, chart theme, and drawer defects
result: Production-built frontend journey passes against local Django

decision: Serialize watchlist reads and writes through loading and pending states
why: Independent review reproduced a stale initial GET overwriting a successful POST
result: Ordering and disabled-control regressions pass; final Retry fix has parent acceptance

decision: Patch Vitest/Vite and minimatch; retain ESLint 9 with coherent plugin peers
why: Initial npm audit had 11 advisories; ESLint 10 trial exposed incompatible Next plugin peers
result: Clean install and zero advisories; upstream ESLint support warning retained

decision: Build Next before explicit typecheck in CI and start a fresh production frontend for browser tests
why: Clean checkouts need generated Next route types and acceptance must not reuse a stale preview
result: Local production browser passes; remote CI has not run

decision: Verify the documented two-service launcher without changing the original database
why: API-only acceptance did not prove canonical frontend startup
result: Both services start; sign-in HTTP 200; API 12 checks and launcher test pass

decision: Accept the narrow local workspace and retain external production gates
why: Docker is unavailable and operational, data-rights, identity, and quant gates remain open
result: Local milestone accepted; no deployment or spending
